thread:
mira.pm: Quick brainstorm: proposing a tenant-pause + reshuffle + warmback playbook for regional rollouts. Primary goals: minimize global impact, protect high-value tenants, and keep model-quality telemetry tight. want lightweight ops steps and clear CS messaging. thoughts?

sam.k: Love it. Can we make the tenant pause soft (traffic diverted to a smaller fraction) instead of hard cut? i.e., micro-throttle a tenant to 10% of its baseline before full pause.

leila.me: Soft pause + micro-throttle makes sense. We need a compact canary metric tuple: p95, 5m error, eval-set quality delta, and infra-cost-per-1k-tokens. Also add a quality-sanity probe using a short seed set.

nate.sre: Ops considerations: when pausing a tenant, avoid immediate capacity spikes by running a reshuffle job that gradually reassigns the freed capacity over 10m windows. Also ensure rehydration (warmback) uses cached KV state where possible.

mira.pm: here's a starter policy sketch: break rollout into micro-slices (0.25% -> 0.75% -> 2%); each step is 20m. For tenant signals: if tenant p95 > 220ms OR errors > 0.4% OR eval-drop > 1.5% across a 20m window for 3 consecutive windows -> escalate to tenant soft-pause, then hard-pause after 1 more failing window.

eli.prod: fallback plan: Variant-B = eco-quant-v2 (lower mem, no streaming), Variant-C = hosted-region fallback (best-effort). During fallback we disable streaming + function-calls for affected requests.

cass.cs: From CS perspective, we need per-tenant visible status in Console and a one-click pause/unpause for support. Also include a comms template so customers get a heads-up and a post-mortem link.

sam.k: I'll add an API endpoint for per-tenant pause that accepts reason + ttl and logs audit events. need RBAC so CS can act but only SREs can global-rollback.

leila.me: propose A/B labels for measurement: A = baseline (streaming on, full precision), B = eco-quant-v2 (streaming off). We'll track quality delta on a daily eval and a micro-eval per-canary window.

nate.sre: checklist for rollout ops:
- shadow traffic run for 45m preflight
- reserve 12% spare capacity in region
- token-burn safety: cap 500k tokens/min extra during reshuffle
- alerts: rolling-p95, rolling-errors, eval-delta, tenant-pause-count

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Starting micro-canary slice 3 (0.25% -> 0.75%) in ap-southeast-1 — runbook_id: RB-2026-022

mira.pm: sample flag YAML (ops):
```yaml
feature_flag: soft_pause_reshuffle_playbook
steps:
  - slice: 0.25%
    duration: 20m
  - slice: 0.75%
    duration: 20m
  - slice: 2.0%
    duration: 45m
tenant_pause_policy:
  soft_throttle_pct: 10
  hard_pause_after_windows: 4
rollback_criteria:
  p95_latency_ms: 220
  error_rate_pct: 0.4
  eval_quality_drop_pct: 1.5
```

sam.k: kill-switch semantics: tenant-level pause only affects that tenant unless >4 tenants pause within 10m -> trigger regional global rollback. Also add a tenant opt-out label for top-tier customers (opt-out prevents auto-pause).

leila.me: to prevent thrash, require 3 consecutive failing windows for auto-pause and a 2-hour cooldown after any auto action. Also log a thrash counter and surface it to the rollout dashboard.

nate.sre: reshuffle algo note: spread load to warm hosts first, then cold, with backpressure thresholds. if reshuffle would exceed token-burn cap, throttle reshuffle rate and notify SRE.

ops-bot: metrics-bot: p95_latency (ap-southeast-1) = 205ms, errors = 0.18% (last 5m)

mira.pm: next steps: 1) finalize YAML thresholds and per-tenant API, 2) schedule dry-run in staging Friday 04:00 UTC, 3) CS review of comms and opt-out handling.

cass.cs: i'll draft the CS template. include: short explanation, likely duration, degraded-features list, contact link, and opt-out info.

sam.k: implementing per-tenant pause API and RBAC. ETA EOD. will gate emergency global-rollback behind 2FA and audit.

leila.me: i'll prepare the micro-eval set and a Grafana tile for per-tenant quality + cost. will also add a delta visualization comparing A vs B per-window.

nate.sre: i'll own the reshuffle job, warmback plan, and a chaos test to simulate repeated tenant pauses to ensure no oscillation.

eli.prod: emergency rollback snippet for engineers: 
```bash
# emergency global rollback (SSO + 2FA required)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"action":"rollback","runbook":"RB-2026-022"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/flags/soft_pause_reshuffle_playbook/rollback
```

mira.pm: any other risks? I'm worried about regression noise from micro-evals — leila, can you add a smoothing window?

leila.me: will add a 3-window EWMA smoothing for eval signals to reduce false positives.

nate.sre: risk: reshuffle causing token-burn spikes -> mitigation: token cap + progressive reshuffle + manual throttle.

cass.cs: risk: customer outrage if paused repeatedly — mitigation: opt-out for high-value tenants + post-action comms + SLA credits playbook if applicable.

mira.pm: thanks team. I'll write the RFC and attach: YAML, CS template, runbook RB-2026-022, and staging dry-run steps. We'll sync after the dry-run and iterate. :white_check_mark:
